title: 地学基礎実験
subtitle: Basic Experiments in Geoscience
teachers:
TOSA Koji
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Learn the use of basic experimental tools correctly and what is necessary for safety throughout basic experiments in geoscience. Learn data analysis of the experimental results using a computer. Plan and conduct geological experiments, and Prepare a report describing the experimental method and results. Learn how to achieve high educational effects in geological experiments when geological experiments conduct.
advice: This course is intended for applicants for teachers of science in junior high school or high school. Learn the safety training, the use of experimental tools and instruments correctly, and the knowledge of data analysis using a computer throughout basic experiments in geoscience for junior high school and high school. Conduct field works such as minerals sampling and stratum observation in addition to indoor experiments. Fieldwork will be conduct on Saturday in April. The order of the experiments may change due to the weather or schedule, check the Student Portal carefully.

requiredKnowledge: It is necessary to a deeper understanding than what you teach in order to teach geological experiments in Junior high school and High school. In order to require knowledge of geoscience in the high school field, review the geoscience field of high school. In this class, learn useful knowledge for teaching geoscience through the experiments.

              Learn the use of basic experimental tools correctly and what is necessary for safety throughout basic experiments in geoscience. Learn data analysis of the experimental results using a computer. Plan and conduct geological experiments, and Prepare a report describing the experimental method and results. Learn how to achieve high educational effects in geological experiments when geological experiments conduct.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course is intended for applicants for teachers of science in junior high school or high school. Learn the safety training, the use of experimental tools and instruments correctly, and the knowledge of data analysis using a computer throughout basic experiments in geoscience for junior high school and high school. Conduct field works such as minerals sampling and stratum observation in addition to indoor experiments. Fieldwork will be conduct on Saturday in April. The order of the experiments may change due to the weather or schedule, check the Student Portal carefully.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              Textbook: Chigaku Kiso Jikkenn (Kanazawa Institute of Technology Publishing)

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              It is necessary to a deeper understanding than what you teach in order to teach geological experiments in Junior high school and High school. In order to require knowledge of geoscience in the high school field, review the geoscience field of high school. In this class, learn useful knowledge for teaching geoscience through the experiments.
